sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Business graduate with hands-on experience in client coordination, data cleaning and weekly reporting across finance and training environments. Works with internal teams and external partners to turn requests into clear documents and on-time deliverables. Combines a Business Administration degree with practical spreadsheet and reporting skills.

Diploma in Business Studies, Sample Polytechnic
Operations Associate
items.sub: Harbour Lane Leasing Sdn. Bhd., Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
bullets: Collect client requirements and supporting documents, then prepare summary notes for internal review and approval.
Check company records and published information to support screening decisions on prospective accounts.
Coordinate with the legal, finance and operations teams to move approved requests through to execution.
Track open items on a shared sheet and follow up with owners before each weekly review.
Prepare a short weekly status note for the operations manager covering open items, blockers and next steps.
Maintain a checklist of required documents per request type so incomplete files are caught early.
Update the team tracker after each review meeting and circulate the notes the same day.

items.title: Administrative Intern
items.sub: Example Training Centre Sdn. Bhd., Shah Alam, Selangor
bullets: Cleaned and merged a 5,000+ row participant list from three sources, reducing duplicate records before a mailing.
Answered 60+ weekly enquiries by email and phone, giving bilingual BM/EN replies and routing requests to the right officer.
Reported broken links found on the centre's registration page to the web team and checked the fix.
Prepared attendance sheets and certificates for two training batches each month.

items.title: Research Assistant (Part-Time)
bullets: Collected and coded survey responses from 120 participants for a faculty study on student spending.
Built summary tables in a spreadsheet and drafted the findings section for the research report.
Checked references and formatting before submission to the supervisor.

items.title: Volunteer Coordinator
bullets: Scheduled 30 volunteers across four venues and sent daily reminders by message.
Handled attendee questions at the help desk and logged recurring issues for the organising team.
Wrote a one-page handover guide for the next year's committee.

items.title: Customer Service Assistant (Part-Time)
bullets: Handled orders and payments accurately during peak hours and resolved customer concerns on the spot.
